incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — 2026-03-15T09:03:19Z — Multiple 5xx/TLS handshake failures observed for api.redwood.ai across EU and US-WEST. Auto-paging oncall.

alice (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a big spike in `tls_handshake_failed` and `proxy_conn_reset` from prod-proxy metrics.

ben (eng-sre): Confirmed. Cloudflare status shows degraded edge termination in several POPs: https://status.cloudflare.com/incident/CF-2026-199 — we're seeing 522/525 + SSL protocol errors.

cara (eng-runtime): Sample from a failing request: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions` -> `* SSL_connect: fatal protocol error` then `SSL: error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:unknown protocol`.

emily (support): Support queue: ~18 tickets mentioning "cert error" or "TLS handshake" in the last 10m, including a couple of enterprise customers. Prioritizing.

dmitri (product): Do we have an immediate mitigation we can push to reduce customer impact while CF investigates? Need something customer-facing to communicate.

alice (oncall): Plan: 1) Fail traffic away from affected CF POPs to our alt_cdn routing pool. 2) Increase TLS handshake timeout on LB and enable connection reuse. 3) Open and escalate ticket with Cloudflare (we already have one). I'm executing step 1 now.

ben (eng-sre): Running route change:
```
$ routemgr promote alt_cdn --selector cf_pop in (AMS,CDG,SIN) --dry=false
```
Applying... propagation started.

incident-bot: Route change detected by control-plane; new route announced to edge-plane (change-id: rchg-20260315-001).

cara (eng-runtime): Rolling config to proxy pools to reduce TLS handshake churn: enabling `keepalive=on`, `max_conn_reuse=1000` and bumping `tls_handshake_timeout` from 3s -> 8s. Rolling restart on proxy-pool-1 (5 instances) now.

alice (oncall): @ben please monitor TLS success rate and error budget. Also paging backup oncall (oncall-override-bot) for coverage.

oncall-override-bot: Paging backup oncall: @ben (eng-sre) assigned as primary for incident handoff.

ben (eng-sre): Ack. Watching metrics — TLS success rate climbing from ~62% -> ~87% in us-west. Still seeing tail errors from a subset of IPs.

emily (support): Drafting status update for status.redwood.ai: short note about third-party CDN provider degradation, affected endpoints, and our mitigations. Will post once we confirm stable routing. :pencil:

dmitri (product): I'll draft an email to enterprise customers with actionable guidance (we're enabling bypass_cdn path for critical customers).

ben (eng-sre): Cloudflare response: "We're investigating an issue in edge TLS termination affecting selective POPs. Config pushes underway." Ticket CF-2026-199 updated. Some CF POPs have had partial rollbacks applied.

cara (eng-runtime): Observed handshake success up to ~94% after our routing change and keepalive patch. Remaining failures look localized to IP ranges hitting legacy POP configs — probably cached routes.

alice (oncall): Support queue trending down. Queue had 18 -> 4 priority tickets in 25 minutes. Good sign.

emily (support): Status post live: "We are experiencing intermittent connectivity due to a third-party CDN provider degradation impacting TLS handshakes. Mitigation steps are in progress; updates to follow." Posted at 09:21 UTC. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-15-cdn-tls

ben (eng-sre): Leaving a short handoff: I've documented the rollback step if routing change causes regressions: `routemgr promote primary_cdn --selector catchall --dry=false` and toggle `edge_tls_fallback=false`. Also run `proxyctl restart --pool proxy-pool-1` after toggling.

cara (eng-runtime): Quick log snippet for postmortem:
```
[2026-03-15T09:05:12Z] proxy-proxy-3 ssl_handshake failed client=10.11.5.22 server=172.31.4.9 err=SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:unknown protocol
[2026-03-15T09:07:01Z] proxy-proxy-2 conn_reuse=0 tls_success=0 src_ip=198.51.100.45 cf_pop=AMS
```

alice (oncall): Criteria to close: TLS success >= 99.9% for 10m and support queue back to baseline. Leaving monitoring to @ben. I'll mark incident as 'monitoring' in incident tracker.

ben (eng-sre): Metrics now at 99.4% over last 5m, errors mostly tied to legacy CF caches. CF says they pushed additional fixes. Will keep watch through the hour.

emily (support): Support update posted to customers and enterprise outreach started. Customers who've opted-in for bypass are routed via `bypass_cdn` and seeing success.

dmitri (product): Thanks team. After we fully stabilize let's prep a short postmortem including timeline, mitigations, and follow-ups (eg. add alternate routing tests and reduce cache TTLs for edge config).

oncall-override-bot: Handoff logged. Next oncall (scheduled): cara (eng-runtime) at 08:00 UTC.

alice (oncall): Handing off primary to @ben for overnight monitoring. I am signing off. :wave:

ben (eng-sre): Ack and will monitor. Leaving a quick runbook note in ops-runbooks for Cloudflare TLS incidents. If we see a regression re-enable `bypass_cdn=true` for critical customer routes and open an incident escalation with Cloudflare support.

emily (support): Final note: queue baseline restored. Closing support incident funnel on this thread.

incident-bot: INCIDENT -> MONITORING (ended major). Root cause: third-party CDN (Cloudflare) edge TLS termination degradation affecting selected POPs; mitigations: traffic failover to alt_cdn, increased LB TLS timeouts, connection reuse, bypass paths for critical customers. Followups: postmortem + routing resilience work item. :white_check_mark:
